title: podocarpus madagascariensis subsp. rotundus
intro: Podocarpus madagascariensis subsp. rotundus, commonly known as the Madagascar Yellowwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Podocarpaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been reported to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Podocarpus madagascariensis subsp. rotundus include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-asthmatic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
